OpsBot: INCIDENT DETECTED: KV-cache resident set growth + continuous-batching cadence stalls on streamer hosts (region: us-west-2). Automatic throttle triggered. Alert: streaming token cadence >1s gap for p50->p95 across 12 hosts. Customers with long-lived streams experiencing partial flush / 503s. Paging oncall.
Alex H: acked. I'm oncall for the hour, taking lead. Setting priority P1 and starting triage.
Maria G: noted. I'm pulling related logs and the kvcache metrics dashboard now. Early guess: a config regression from last night's batch-window tweak combined with a KV eviction bloom that caused cache blowups and forced partial flush fallback.
Samir P: metrics snapshot:
- kv_cache_size_sum (host group streamer-*) jumped 3.8x at 22:07 UTC
- continuous_batch_rate dropped ~40% after spike
- streaming_token_gap p95 = 2.1s -> customers started seeing retries
Logs excerpt (from host streamer-03):
```
2026-02-14T22:06:59Z [warning] kvcache::evict - eviction loop entered, candidate_count=122334
2026-02-14T22:07:01Z [error] batch::cadence - partial_flush triggered, pending_tokens=1800
2026-02-14T22:07:03Z [info] stream::out - send failed, code=503, reason=partial_flush
```
Alex H: good details. Who last changed batch_window and kv_prefetch config? I see a rollout at 21:50 UTC (deploy id: rwd-deploy/2026-02-14-2150, PR #4582).
Maria G: PR #4582 touched `serve/runtime/batching/config.yaml` - key `continuous_batch_window_ms` reduced from 120 -> 40 to improve latency. That likely reduced effective batching and increased eviction churn under heavy KV miss rates.
Josh T: we have an open customer ticket from AcmeApps reporting streaming failures since 22:10. Support case #CS-7891. CS flagged it as degraded but not fully down.
Alex H: mitigation plan proposal:
1) Immediately revert `continuous_batch_window_ms` to 120ms in runtime config via a hotpatch to canary hosts (10% of streamer pool).
2) Apply a temporary stricter kv_prefetch_limit to reduce memory growth.
3) Monitor p50/p95 token cadence and errors. If canary looks good, rollout to 50% then 100%.
Samir P: I can push the canary. Suggested `kubectl patch` command:
```
kubectl -n redwood set env ds/streamer CONT_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=120 --overwrite
kubectl -n redwood set env ds/streamer KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT=50 --overwrite
```
Alex H: do it. Mark the change in incident timeline. Also add a config rollback tag to telemetry so we can filter.
OpsBot: @alex-h @samir-p - oncall takeover logged. Incident channel pinned. Pager duty: page escalation if no progress in 15m.
Samir P: canary applied to streamer-canary1..4 (10% hosts). Rolling patch output:
- canary1 OK
- canary2 OK
- canary3 crashloop on old kernel (unrelated), skipped
- canary4 OK
Maria G: early telemetry 2m after canary:
- streaming_token_gap p95 dropped from 2.1s -> 0.22s on canary hosts
- kv_cache_size growth rate normalized
Alex H: looks promising. Start 50% rollout.
Samir P: 50% patch done. Monitoring.
Josh T: AcmeApps confirms improvement in streaming at 22:30 UTC on canary routes.
Laura W: tagging for next shift handoff: I'll take over at 23:00 UTC. Any outstanding blockers?
Alex H: two follow-ups: (A) investigate why eviction bloom happened — create replay and heap dump for affected hosts; (B) create automated integration test to catch small batch window regressions against load profile.
Samir P: after 50->100% rollout (completed 22:38), overall metrics:
- stream success rate improved from 92% -> 99.6%
- p95 latency recovered to baseline
- error 503 rate dropped 98%
OpsBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: partial flush errors resolved post-rollout. Auto-throttle cleared. Proceeding to status: mitigated.
Maria G: root cause hypothesis for postmortem: aggressive reduction of `continuous_batch_window_ms` in PR #4582 reduced batching opportunities, increasing per-request memory/KV miss rate under heavy long-lived streams. This caused cache churn and eviction storms, which in turn triggered the partial flush path in streaming runtime.
Alex H: final actions:
- File postmortem: owner @maria-g
- Revert/backstop policy: require load test gate for any tuning to `continuous_batch_window_ms` (owner: eng-runtime)
- Add automated alert for kv_cache_growth > 2x sustained over 5m
Laura W: taking handoff. I'll verify follow-ups and create the postmortem draft with timeline. I'll also coordinate a customer follow-up note for AcmeApps and two other affected tenants (NimbusCo, DataCart).
Josh T: adding support notes and CS draft to share with customers.
Alex H: thanks everyone. Marking incident resolved at 22:44 UTC. Leave channel open for any late regressions.
OpsBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation confirmed. Postmortem assigned.
